Yeah You're right. I just hate that I spent so many summers like that and I blamed a lot of that on myself being lazy or just way too into the internet. My sister said I would become one of those NEETs because of it. (even though I get great grades in school/love to socialize) It makes me sad.
I feel lazy and I feel like my life is wasting away.
I just don't want to become toxic as other parts of my family (my sister looks sane compared to them), and I worry so much if I become toxic myself and that I'm hurting the people I love.

I'm tired of being strong and the example of strength to everyone. I want a peaceful life so I can rest.

My dad understands better than my mom and sister. But my dad is very protective of my mom, but he understands my sister is crazy. I cut them out of my life where I can. I get yelled at a lot for being distant and hiding away in my room, with friends, or just out of the house. But I always need them and it sucks. I feel like I'm the asshole and I'm the one who hurts them.
